item.title: Firefox Merges Support for Vulkan Video Decoding
item.description:
📝 Following recent activity in Firefox development, this bug report opened three months ago over the lack of Vulkan Video support in Firefox was closed. The Firefox 153 release due out in July will have Vulkan Video decoding support available. 0 is expected for release on 21 July with this Vulkan Video support assuming no last minute issues.
🔗 Read more: https://www.phoronix.com/news/Firefox-Vulkan-Video-Merged
